title: Making your phone easier on your eyes and ears: the settings worth ten minutes

posts.facebook:
Your phone can make its own text bigger, magnify a menu, caption a video and talk to your hearing aids. Nobody tells you where the switches are.

Step-by-step, from Apple's and Google's own support pages, for making text larger, using the built-in magnifier, turning on live captions and pairing hearing aids on iPhone and Android. Includes what to search for when the menu names differ.

Spend ten minutes in the Accessibility section of Settings: bigger text first, then magnifier, captions and hearing devices.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/tech/phone-accessibility-settings-eyes-and-ears/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
